description: List a Clipform form's individual responses (submissions) with time filtering - complements clipform_get_results (aggregates). Answers questions like 'what came in during the last 24 hours', 'what's the longest answer', 'what did people say'. Text answers plus a non-PII payment summary (amount and status); contact details, file uploads, and audio/video answers are redacted to placeholders and the customer's payment details stay in the dashboard (the responses URL from clipform_get_form). Responses are sorted newest first unless sort: 'oldest'. Needs a signed-in Clipform account (an anonymous session is asked to sign in).

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence - not the tool you're calling.

query.description: Only responses whose text answers contain this string (case-insensitive)

since.description: Only responses submitted at or after this ISO 8601 time (e.g. '2026-08-29T00:00:00Z')

sort.description: Order by submission time. Default: newest

until.description: Only responses submitted at or before this ISO 8601 time

name: clipform_get_responses

locked_over_plan_limit.description: Matching responses hidden by the plan's response limit

responses.description: Matching responses, filtered/sorted/capped per the inputs

answer.description: Text answer, or a redaction placeholder

total_matching.description: Responses matching the filters (before the limit cap)

title: List form responses
